title: NEXT F SEO Contract Registry
description: Generated index of authoritative Phase 7 SEO definitions.

schemas.name: Alternate Language URL
schemas.description: One hreflang-style alternate URL declaration.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes multilingual alternate URL data used by metadata and sitemaps.

fields.description: BCP 47 language/region tag. Null only for x-default.
Whether this is the x-default alternate.

validationRules.description: Exactly one of a languageTag or isDefault=true must identify the alternate.
url must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL.
Implementations should validate reciprocal alternate relationships where applicable.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: SEO Audit Issue
schemas.description: One diagnostic SEO finding with severity and remediation guidance.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes audit findings while clearly separating advisory analysis from search-engine ranking guarantees.

fields.description: Optional contract field path associated with the issue.

validationRules.description: Audit evidence must not contain secrets or unnecessary personal data.
A warning or passing check is advisory and must not be represented as a search ranking guarantee.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: SEO Audit Result
schemas.description: Timestamped SEO analysis summary for a Site URL or target entity.
schemas.purpose: Creates a reusable operational result for CMS SEO health dashboards and automated checks.

fields.description: NEXT F audit score expressed in percentage points.

relationships.description: May audit a canonical content/entity target.
Contains zero or more standardized findings.

validationRules.description: score is a NEXT F diagnostic metric only and is not a Google, Bing or other search-engine score.
checksPassed and checksFailed must be non-negative and reflect the executed audit rule set.
checkedAt and derived findings represent a historical run and should not be edited as current content.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Broken Link Record
schemas.description: Operational record for a link that fails or resolves undesirably.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes broken-link health reporting and remediation workflow.

fields.description: Destination that failed or behaved unexpectedly.
First detection time for this finding.

validationRules.description: httpStatus and failureType record observed checks and must not be fabricated.
resolved should normally follow a successful recheck or explicit human override.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Indexing Status
schemas.description: Normalized indexability/indexing state for one inspected URL.
schemas.purpose: Provides a stable provider-neutral indexing status that can be shown in CMS diagnostics.

fields.description: Provider or NEXT F normalized explanation.

validationRules.description: indexable means the URL is eligible according to known rules; it does not promise a search engine will index or rank it.
Indexing state must identify the source of the determination.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Internal Link Record
schemas.description: Derived record of one internal link between two Site URLs.
schemas.purpose: Supports link audits and internal-link analysis without turning operational crawl data into editable content.

fields.description: When this link relationship was last discovered.

validationRules.description: sourceUrl and targetUrl must belong to the same logical Site after canonical host/URL normalization.
Internal link records are derived; customers edit the source content rather than this record.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Keyword Set
schemas.description: Primary focus keyword plus secondary and semantically related terms.
schemas.purpose: Provides one reusable keyword-planning object for CMS SEO editors.

fields.description: Related entities, terms or semantic phrases.

relationships.description: Uses one canonical primary Keyword Target.

validationRules.description: The primary phrase must not be duplicated in secondaryKeywords after normalization.
Keyword sets are editorial optimization inputs, not search-volume or ranking claims.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Keyword Target
schemas.description: One intentional search phrase and its targeting context.
schemas.purpose: Standardizes focus-keyword targeting without treating keyword repetition as a ranking guarantee.

validationRules.description: The contract records targeting intent only and must not imply keyword density or repetition guarantees ranking.
Non-null locale should use a valid BCP 47 language tag.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: SEO Metadata
schemas.description: Canonical per-target SEO metadata record used by Customer CMS editors and website renderers.
schemas.purpose: Centralizes title, description, keywords, canonical, robots, social metadata, structured data and language alternates without duplicating SEO fields in every Content contract.

fields.description: Content or other routable entity this metadata describes.
Search-result title override. Length guidance is an audit recommendation, not a hard ranking rule.
Search-result description suggestion. Search engines may choose different snippets.
Optional focus and supporting keyword targets.
Most recent SEO metadata update timestamp.

relationships.description: Attaches metadata to a canonical target entity.

validationRules.description: At most one active seo.metadata record may exist for a target entity and locale context unless a future localization contract defines variants.
canonicalUrl must not include a URL fragment.
Production canonical URLs should use HTTPS except explicitly approved exceptional environments.
Metadata validation and scores must never be presented as ranking guarantees.
metaDescription is a suggested snippet and must not be represented as controlling a search engine result.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Open Graph Metadata
schemas.description: Open Graph sharing metadata for a routable target.
schemas.purpose: Provides provider-neutral social sharing values without hardcoding tags into customer site templates.

relationships.description: Uses canonical media references for social images.

validationRules.description: Rendered social image must resolve publicly when the target is public.
Null values may fall back to seo.metadata or seo.siteDefaults according to implementation rules.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Redirect
schemas.description: Canonical Site redirect rule.
schemas.purpose: Allows Customer CMS and runtime adapters to manage redirects without embedding provider-specific server configuration in content code.

fields.description: Site-relative source path including leading slash.
Whether incoming query parameters are preserved when supported by the adapter.

validationRules.description: sourcePath must start with / and must not include scheme or host.
A redirect must not resolve back to its source or create a detected cycle.
Implementations should identify and consolidate avoidable multi-hop redirect chains.
Only one enabled redirect may own the same normalized sourcePath per Site.
destinationUrl must use HTTP or HTTPS.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Robots Directive
schemas.description: Per-document meta robots behavior.
schemas.purpose: Separates page-level indexing directives from robots.txt crawl policy.

fields.description: Whether cached/archive presentation should be discouraged where supported.
Whether snippets should be suppressed where supported.
Optional maximum snippet length directive, -1 meaning no explicit limit where supported.
Optional maximum video preview seconds, -1 meaning no explicit limit where supported.

validationRules.description: This contract governs page-level robots metadata and must not be used as a robots.txt replacement.
When noSnippet is true, maxSnippet is advisory/ignored by renderers.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Robots.txt Policy
schemas.description: Site-level robots.txt rules and sitemap references.
schemas.purpose: Provides a structured robots.txt source without exposing arbitrary server configuration.

fields.description: Optional non-directive comment text for generated robots.txt.

validationRules.description: robots.txt policy must not invent a noindex directive; indexing directives belong in seo.robotsDirective.
Every sitemap URL must be absolute HTTP(S).
Allow rules do not grant application authorization; security cannot rely on robots.txt.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Robots.txt Rule
schemas.description: One robots.txt user-agent allow/disallow rule.
schemas.purpose: Keeps crawler-path policy separate from page-level meta robots.

validationRules.description: This contract is only for robots.txt crawl policy, not index/noindex metadata.
path should be empty or begin with / according to the intended robots.txt semantics.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Search Performance
schemas.description: Provider-neutral organic search performance metrics for a defined date range and dimensions.
schemas.purpose: Supports CMS SEO reporting while keeping external provider identity and freshness explicit.

fields.description: Observed click-through rate in percentage points.
Observed average position when supplied by the provider.
Time NEXT F received/imported this metric set.

relationships.description: May be dimensioned by one search query.

validationRules.description: endDate must not precede startDate.
clicks must not exceed impressions for comparable provider semantics.
ctr should equal clicks / impressions * 100 within accepted rounding tolerance when impressions > 0.
Metrics must identify their source provider and import time; the CMS must not present stale or synthetic data as live provider data.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Search Preview
schemas.description: Derived search-result preview from canonical SEO metadata and Site defaults.
schemas.purpose: Supports the Customer CMS editor preview while making clear that actual search engines may render different titles and snippets.

fields.description: Description character count for UI guidance.
Whether values came from explicit metadata, site defaults or content fallback.

validationRules.description: The preview is an approximation; search engines may rewrite titles, snippets and displayed URLs.
Character counts are editor guidance only and must not be enforced as hard search-engine limits.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Search Query Dimension
schemas.description: Normalized organic-search query dimension used in imported performance data.
schemas.purpose: Provides provider-neutral query context for search performance reports without treating external integrations as canonical content.

fields.description: Optional ISO-style country/market code supplied by the data source.

validationRules.description: query represents observed/imported data and must not be auto-generated as if it were measured performance.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.

schemas.name: Site SEO Defaults
schemas.description: Site-level default SEO values applied when target-specific metadata does not override them.
schemas.purpose: Gives Customer CMS one safe place for default title templates, descriptions, robots and social metadata.

fields.description: Optional page-title template containing a single %s placeholder.

relationships.description: Defaults are scoped to one Site.
May define default Open Graph values.

validationRules.description: At most one active Site SEO Defaults record exists per Site and locale strategy.
When titleTemplate is non-null it must contain exactly one %s content-title placeholder unless a future template contract defines additional tokens.
Target-specific seo.metadata values override defaults.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Sitemap Entry
schemas.description: One canonical URL eligible for an XML sitemap.
schemas.purpose: Provides a host-independent sitemap data contract for public indexable URLs and multilingual alternates.

fields.description: Optional truthful last meaningful content modification time.

validationRules.description: Sitemap URLs must be public canonical URLs eligible for indexing.
Targets explicitly marked noindex must not appear in a generated public sitemap.
lastModifiedAt must reflect meaningful content modification and must not be automatically refreshed solely because of deployment.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Social Card Metadata
schemas.description: Generic social-card metadata for networks that use title, description and image card values.
schemas.purpose: Allows CMS social-preview controls without coupling canonical content to one advertising/social vendor.

relationships.description: Uses canonical media reference for card images.

validationRules.description: Vendor-specific account handles and API credentials do not belong in this canonical social-card contract.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: Structured Data
schemas.description: One structured-data JSON-LD object and validation state.
schemas.purpose: Supports schema.org-style structured data without allowing executable script payloads or fabricated claims.

fields.description: Primary structured-data type name, such as Organization, Article, Product or FAQPage.
JSON-compatible structured-data object without script tags or executable values.
How the structured-data object was produced.

validationRules.description: payload must be a JSON object/array appropriate for JSON-LD and must not include executable code, functions or <script> markup.
Structured data must describe visible or otherwise legitimately represented content and must not fabricate reviews, prices, availability or organizational claims.
schemaType must correspond to the primary @type represented by payload when present.

delivery.notes: Public delivery is allowed only when the parent Site/API explicitly exposes this SEO data.

schemas.name: URL Inspection Result
schemas.description: Timestamped crawl/indexing inspection details for a Site URL.
schemas.purpose: Supports provider and NEXT F URL inspection diagnostics without making external provider output part of editable content.

fields.description: Canonical declared by the inspected page when available.
Canonical selected/reported by the inspection source when available.
Whether crawling was reported as allowed when available.
Most recent crawl time reported by the source.

validationRules.description: Inspection results are snapshots and must always include checkedAt and sourceProvider.
selectedCanonical is observed provider output and must not automatically overwrite seo.metadata.canonicalUrl.
CMS should expose inspection freshness rather than presenting an old result as current.

delivery.notes: Operational SEO data is private by default and is not part of unauthenticated public content responses.
